status.description: Contact status. Possible values include NEW, ACTIVE, LONG_TERM, and CLIENT.

contactMethod.description: Entry method such as WHATSAPP, FB_LEADADS, FORM, CHATBOT, API, or ZAPIER.

note.description: Simple note stored on the contact log.

scheduleStatusTo.description: Future status to apply on the scheduled date.

scheduleDate.description: Date when the scheduled status should replace the current status.

sellSuscription.description: Sell subscription type such as ONE_TIME, MONTHLY_SUSCRIPTION, YEARLY_SUSCRIPTION, or OTHER_SELL_TYPE.
